decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works hereby granted shall be limited to a temporary period of one year expiring 31st October 2003 after which the wall shall be rebuilt to its previous condition, and the gates rehung in their original position.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the works is completed and has been approved.
description: Partial demolition of boundary wall to provide proposed temporary site access and after rebuild wall as existing. (Listed Building)
